cases.name: Patricia Patsy Miller
cases.narrative: He stripped completely naked to avoid leaving evidence, hid in her closet and spied on her as she did chores. He had unsuccessfully attempted to strangled her with the belt on her bathrobe, then beat the back of her head with a hammer and set the bed she was on fire.

cases.name: Sha'Dayla A. Johnson
cases.about: She she was a graduate of Palm Bay Magnet High School and had been making plans to leave her job at Walmart and go to college.
cases.narrative: He allegedly ambushed her as she left for work, shooting her 15 times.
